judgement.itemRank: Proposed, not yet confirmed by review.
judgement.minAge: No age floors on any item. JUDGEMENT, NOT A CITATION - no source floors anything, and source 6's derivation at age 5 was deliberately not converted into a floor on item 2 (decision 7).
judgement.item24: Item 24 (bite / even occlusion) is excluded even though source 1 marks it 'subjective or objective'. JUDGEMENT, NOT A CITATION (decision 4).
judgement.proposedForV1: Items 8, 9 and 10 are askable and deliberately not proposed for v1 generation. JUDGEMENT, NOT A CITATION.
judgement.item1: Item 1 is a stopgap for a missing GROUP_GATE.mouth = 'mechanism'. It must be dropped from the bank if that gate is ever added (decision 6). JUDGEMENT, NOT A CITATION.
judgement.item2fact: Item 2 reuses the existing fact 'eating-drinking' (sore-throat s-011/s-012). Items 11-14 in the packet map onto 'hurts-to-swallow', 'hard-to-breathe' and 'feels-feverish' and are NOT re-asked here; see decision 10.
judgement.unenforceableCautions: Decision 5's POSITIVE requirement -- item 7 candidates must anchor to the injury or to a change -- cannot be a phrase ban. The regression it guards against ('Do you have a loose tooth?') passes the screen cleanly, so item 7 needs a human eye at review.
